content: Existing Qasida Burda / Mawlid apps (Google Play: Qasida Burda Sharif, Burda Baith, Qaseeda Burda with Urdu) share: full Arabic verse text with adjustable zoom/font size, offline access, bookmark/favorites for verses, share-to-social (WhatsApp/social), and audio recitation with multilingual (Urdu/Arabic/English) translation alongside the poem. These apps are typically simple single-purpose readers, low production value, ad-supported, and rarely support multiple burdahs in one app (mostly single-poem apps).
